      "link": "https://audioboom.com/posts/8797448",
      "description": "On Pottering this week, things take a splendidly spooky turn as we celebrate Halloween in the garden with broadcaster, author and bewitching presence Angela Scanlon! You can also watch each episode of Pottering on my YouTube channel. Just search for @tomallen .
